candidate.details: OLD-only OMP3 selects three pair factors from 15 standard pair Walsh features and fixes historical OLD predictions. Enumerate all 6!=720 action-coordinate mappings in NEW; fit three coefficients + intercept for each mapping using regularized ridge to old coefficients (alpha=.5 and intercept ridge .001); map posterior from NEW controlled pair-difference residual likelihood plus fitted prior penalty, temperature .46; posterior-weighted NEW/COLD predictions.
candidate.limitations: Provided pairwise factor algebra and permutation grammar; not spontaneous invention of mapping grammar, universal operator discovery, novel native Yggdrasil weights, or official cumulative training.
candidate.name: contrast_refit

compute.audit: auditor independently implements source generator key replay, intervention disjointness, supervised model refits and all 720 mapping predictions, without importing scorer; shares NumPy/sklearn numerical implementations and disclosed synthetic generator, so not fully independent scientific replication.
compute.runtime: Python 3.13.5, NumPy 2.3.5, sklearn 1.8.0, SciPy 1.17.0, single CPU with BLAS env thread=1; exact 720 map refits per world, posterior and standard models, independent audit and exact-source timing-omitted deterministic replay. No GPU, runner, third-party paid API or external owner action.
compute.source_dev_pilot: Seed 998317 world0 across three families scored and independently audited 13,618 checks before source freeze; not prospective. No prospective seeds scored before GitHub source and prereg commits.

controls.bayes_fixed: fixed_bayes: exact 720 candidate maps with frozen old coefficients; NEW likelihood temperature .45.
controls.direct_matched: full_bayes_refit: identical old support, identical exact 720 map candidates and independently fitted 4-variable ridge coefficients, identical 36 NEW labels, posterior from full-label residual + prior penalty at temperature .38 (equal map enumeration/refit).
controls.fairness: All arms get same OLD72+NEW36 witnessed data and same held test; matching exact 720 mapping/refit control has equal enumeration/fit work as candidate. Other conventional models have different inductive bias and compute; no equal-compute claim for all arms.
fully_trained: new_pair_elasticnet: ElasticNet alpha .035 L1 .8 on all 15 first-six pair Walsh features, NEW only
new_degree4_elasticnet: same fully trained ElasticNet on all pair plus 4-way Walsh features (30, deliberately strong novel-operator control)
new_pair_omp: 3 term OMP on 15 NEW pair features
new_pair_ridge: Ridge alpha1 on all 15 NEW pair features
new_extra_trees: ExtraTrees 48 trees, min leaf 2, seeded
naive_old: old checkpoint used without permutation inference
shuffled_new: matched-label sham, roll NEW labels and train 30-feature ElasticNet

data.causal_actions: 8 binary do variables, 252 distinct underlying action identities of 256 possible per world, exactly OLD72 + NEW36 + OLD_HELD48 + NEW_HELD48 + COLD_HELD48
families: permuted factors with one reweighted pair coefficient and bias shift
permuted factors plus novel 4-way parity outside pairwise mapping grammar
data.generator: ENERGY64-V1 deterministic independent SHA256-keyed action, truth, nuisance and Gaussian noise streams
data.interventions: NEW has 18 one-bit controlled pairs, three per each of first six source do variables (all outcomes available to each arm). OLD training 72 observed intervention outcomes.
data.leakage: Every method sees identical OLD72+NEW36 outcomes; held outcomes unavailable to learners, disjoint causal assignments across every train and test stream; synthetic generator authored by experimenter and independently checked but not an external dataset.
data.remapping: Unseen uniform random permutation of first six causal input positions in NEW/COLD; both 720-map search family and first-six restriction SUPPLIED to both mapping methods; true permutation withheld. Two other causal assignment bits plus two correlated nuisance bits are observed.
data.truth: Three signed pairwise Walsh primitive response factors on source bits (0,1),(2,3),(4,5); iid Gaussian response noise sigma=.18. Two correlated nuisance inputs shift across old/new and randomize at cold. Per permutation support/true coefficients/held labels unavailable to learners.

decision.INVALID: Source or protocol not committed before prospective scoring, drifted source/dependencies, any held leak or assignment overlap, failure to reproduce or independently refit predictions, or missing strong comparator.
decision.SCREEN_NO_GO: Any critical screening gate FAIL or fewer than 8/9 pass, provided independent auditor/replay and data validity PASS; preserve 24 worlds and STOP (no primary, no tuning).
decision.SCREEN_PROMISING: All three critical screening gates PASS plus at least 8/9 total PASS, all 24 fresh worlds independently audited and replayed. Only then primary eligible on three untouched 36-world seeds. No scientific pass claimed from screen.
decision.development_primary: Only if screen promising, same frozen source on 3 reserved primary seeds with independently audited identical gates required for external development provisional GO. Always separately from native Yggdrasil acceptance.

frozen_gates.cold_vs_fixed_bayes_5pct: Candidate cold <=.95*fixed coefficient exact 720 map posterior cold MSE
frozen_gates.cold_vs_full_posterior_3pct: Candidate aggregate cold MSE <=.97*exact matched full_bayes_refit pooled cold MSE
frozen_gates.cold_vs_naive_old_20pct: Candidate cold <=.8*unmapped no-adapt old model cold MSE
frozen_gates.cold_vs_strongest_other_5pct: Candidate aggregate cold MSE <=.95*minimum other nonsham comparator pooled cold MSE
frozen_gates.family_noninferiority_10pct: Candidate cold MSE <=1.10*best comparator separately in ALL three world families
frozen_gates.old_exact_retained: Old historical held MSE of all ten arms matches same frozen old OMP3 within 1e-11 per case
frozen_gates.posterior_spread_exercised: Average entropy of proposed permutation posterior >=.25 nats
frozen_gates.seed_positive_each: Candidate lower cold MSE than best comparator in BOTH prospectively reserved screening seeds

evaluation.score: Unweighted per-world MSE on 48 OLD, 48 NEW, 48 cold held outcomes, report aggregate/by seed/family. OLD held head remains frozen for all arms.

hypothesis: Context-independent OLD causal factor supports can transfer across unseen action-variable permutations using intervention-difference posterior mapping, improving cold held-out prediction >5% over the strongest same-observation conventional model AND >3% over exactly matched 720-map fully Bayesian posterior refitting, independently in both screen seed cohorts while freezing OLD historical readout.
